text: Given a mocked vendor GET /api/Users response with two users, When msp360_list_users is called, Then the response has count: 2, two users entries each with exactly user_id/email/company/enabled/space_used_kb, and has_more: false.
Given a mocked vendor GET /api/Users response with zero users, When msp360_list_users is called, Then the response is {"users": [], "count": 0, "has_more": false} and not an error envelope.

Given the vendor login call (POST /api/Provider/Login) returns 401, When msp360_list_users is called, Then the result is {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "retryable": false, ...}} and the mocked GET /api/Users client is never invoked.

Given the request to the MCP server is missing the X-Msp360-Username header, When msp360_list_users is called, Then the server responds HTTP 401 listing the required headers, and no HTTP call to MSP360 is made.
note: dev leg: the credential middleware runs before any tool dispatch on /mcp, so this generic, already-existing PRD-21273 test covers msp360_list_users too; not duplicated per-tool.

text: Given two concurrent requests with different credentials (tenant A's mocked vendor response returns user "alice@acme.test", tenant B's returns "bob@contoso.test"), When msp360_list_users is called for each, Then tenant A's result contains only "alice@acme.test" and tenant B's only "bob@contoso.test", with no cross-tenant mixing.

Given a mocked vendor 200 login response containing a distinctive access_token value, When msp360_list_users is called and its response body and all captured log output are searched for that exact string, Then the string is not found anywhere.
Given a mocked vendor response with 60 users, When msp360_list_users() is called with no arguments, Then exactly 50 are returned and has_more: true.
Given the same 60-user mock, When msp360_list_users(limit=200) is called, Then all 60 are returned and has_more: false.
Given the same 60-user mock, When msp360_list_users(limit=500) is called, Then at most 200 are returned (the hard cap wins over the requested limit).
Given the /api/Users call times out or returns a 5xx response, When msp360_list_users is called, Then the result is {"error": {"code": "upstream_error", "retryable": true, ...}}.

Given a mocked vendor response with one enabled user (Enabled: true) and one disabled user (Enabled: false), When msp360_list_users is called with no filter, Then both appear in the result with their actual enabled values.
